question.text: A charged dust particle of radius <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>5</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>7</mn></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi></math> is located in a horizontal electric field having an intensity of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6.28</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>5</mn></msup><mi> </mi><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo> </mo><msup><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup></math>.
